## Connections that drive true transformation.

Real progress happens when the right things come together: expertise and data, insights and human
ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real,
turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.
[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

## Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.
[Honeywell C300 product image]

Autonomy isn't a switch we flip. It's a journey taken together. We build on the control systems
customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# Integration of IT with OT Systems

for production efficiency and maximization

expert in bridging the gap between IT and OT

 

## [][1]
## Consultancy &  Management Areas

### [][2]
### Level 1. Process equipment

Integrate field devices, sensors, actuators, and hardware into your production process. 
At this point, you will get assistance with deployment of devices that inform the PLC about the
situation: temperature, position, distance, etc. 

### [][3]
### Level 2. Control network

Order consultation for incorporating PLCs and HMIs to control the Process Network.
Control manufacturing processes and industrial equipment.

### [][4]
### Level 3. Supervision systems

Get support with the integration of SCADA to connect a number of PLCs and coordinate them together.

Implement AI into your manufacturing processes to read and analyze information in real-time and make
decisions immediately.

### [][5]
### Level 4. ERP Systems

Get advice on how to control the ERP (or Enterprise Resource Planning) system. It comprises diverse
activities like accounting, procurement, project management, supply chain operations, and risk
management. The system also includes enterprise performance management software, which assists in
planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting on an organization's financial outcomes.

### [][6]
### International Multidiscipline Project Management

I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to every project I undertake. With a comprehensive
understanding of diverse fields, I am equipped to oversee projects of all kinds and ensure their
success.
Multidiscipline Projects: - Food Processing: Project Director / Manager, Construction Management,
Automation and Proces Control, Utilities, Waste Water Treatment- IT & OT Project Director /
Manager  

### [][7]
### Information Management

With my expertise as a project manager, I can help streamline information management for your
factory. By utilizing effective project management strategies, I can help organize and optimize data
flow, increasing productivity and efficiency across your entire operation.

Let me help you achieve your manufactory’s full potential through effective information management.

You will receive all the necessary support and recommendations for factory automation and unifying
Information Technology with Operation Technology systems. I can provide you with assistance on any
of the following levels. 

Project
Management

Food & Beverage

Requirements Analysis

Advanced Process Control

Risk Assessment 

Manufacturing Processing

## Founder

### [][9]
### Arjan Taal

With a successful track record in Industrial Automation, OT and IT processes and multi-disciplinary
project management, I have brought my skills through years of experience in the food production
industry, engineering, and IT.

In addition to my extensive experience, I am also fluent in English, Dutch, and German, and know a
bit of Russian. This allows me to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders,
regardless of their language or location.

My diverse background has equipped me with a unique perspective, enabling me to manage complex
projects with precision and ease. Let me put my skills to work for you and help take your project to
the next level!

# Integration of IT with OT Systems

for production efficiency and maximization

expert in bridging the gap between IT and OT

 

## [][1]
## Consultancy &  Management Areas

### [][2]
### Level 1. Process equipment

Integrate field devices, sensors, actuators, and hardware into your production process. 
At this point, you will get assistance with deployment of devices that inform the PLC about the
situation: temperature, position, distance, etc. 

### [][3]
### Level 2. Control network

Order consultation for incorporating PLCs and HMIs to control the Process Network.
Control manufacturing processes and industrial equipment.

### [][4]
### Level 3. Supervision systems

Get support with the integration of SCADA to connect a number of PLCs and coordinate them together.

Implement AI into your manufacturing processes to read and analyze information in real-time and make
decisions immediately.

### [][5]
### Level 4. ERP Systems

Get advice on how to control the ERP (or Enterprise Resource Planning) system. It comprises diverse
activities like accounting, procurement, project management, supply chain operations, and risk
management. The system also includes enterprise performance management software, which assists in
planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting on an organization's financial outcomes.

### [][6]
### International Multidiscipline Project Management

I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to every project I undertake. With a comprehensive
understanding of diverse fields, I am equipped to oversee projects of all kinds and ensure their
success.
Multidiscipline Projects: - Food Processing: Project Director / Manager, Construction Management,
Automation and Proces Control, Utilities, Waste Water Treatment- IT & OT Project Director /
Manager  

### [][7]
### Information Management

With my expertise as a project manager, I can help streamline information management for your
factory. By utilizing effective project management strategies, I can help organize and optimize data
flow, increasing productivity and efficiency across your entire operation.

Let me help you achieve your manufactory’s full potential through effective information management.

You will receive all the necessary support and recommendations for factory automation and unifying
Information Technology with Operation Technology systems. I can provide you with assistance on any
of the following levels. 

Project
Management

Food & Beverage

Requirements Analysis

Advanced Process Control

Risk Assessment 

Manufacturing Processing

## [][8]
## Founder

### [][9]
### Arjan Taal

With a successful track record in Industrial Automation, OT and IT processes and multi-disciplinary
project management, I have brought my skills through years of experience in the food production
industry, engineering, and IT.

In addition to my extensive experience, I am also fluent in English, Dutch, and German, and know a
bit of Russian. This allows me to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders,
regardless of their language or location.

My diverse background has equipped me with a unique perspective, enabling me to manage complex
projects with precision and ease. Let me put my skills to work for you and help take your project to
the next level!

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

## Features

*[ProBalance][57]*
  ProBalance is our famously efficacious algorithm to maintain PC responsiveness during high CPU
  loads.
*[CPU Affinities][58]*
  Set permanent CPU affinities so that processes run on the desired set of CPUs every time they
  launch.
*[CPU Sets][59]*
  A ‘softer’ form of CPU Affinities that are more like preferred cores.
*[Priorities][60]*
  Set permanent priorities so that processes run with them every time.
*[Efficiency Mode][61]*
  Control and persist Windows 11’s Efficiency Mode, which designates processes as not performance
  critical to help keep them out of the way.
*[Disallowed Processes][62]*
  Immediately terminate any matched process, by your criteria.
*[Limit Instances][63]*
  Limit the number of instances a process may have in a user session.
*[Instance Balancer][64]*
  Spread CPU cores among running instances of application(s).
*[CPU Limiter][65]*
  Dynamically, temporarily limit CPU utilization of a process when it reaches a threshold.
*[Group Extender][66]*
  Enable processor group unaware applications to make full use of the CPU.
*[Power Profile Automation][67]*
  Switch power plans while idle ([IdleSaver][68]), or when specified process(es) are found running,
  or by a manual timer (Keep Awake), etc…
*[Prevent Sleep][69] (Keep Awake)*
  Process Lasso can prevent your PC from sleeping for a specified amount of time, or when select
  processes are running.
*[Disable Hyper-Threading or SMT][70]*
  Dynamically disable Hyper-Threading or SMT on a per-process basis.
*[Advanced Watchdog Rules][71]*
  Create advanced rules to perform a specified action when matched process(es) reach a certain
  threshold of resource consumption or other criteria.
*[Multi-select Operations][72]*
  Perform an operation like terminate on multiple processes at once!
*[Configuration Profiles][73]*
  Profiles allows for creation and use of multiple rule configurations.
*More…*
  Process Lasso contains numerous other features and functions. Explore them for yourself!

## About Process Lasso

Process Lasso is Windows process automation and optimization software. Think of it as an automated
task manager. From tuning algorithms like [ProBalance][84] to user-created rules and persistent
settings such as CPU affinities and priority classes, Process Lasso gives you complete control to
run processes YOUR way!

Our novel ProBalance algorithm helps maintain system responsiveness during high CPU loads by
dynamically adjusting the priorities of running programs to keep problematic background processes in
check. With ProBalance, no longer will single, or multiple, processes be able to bring your system
to a virtual stall. Process Lasso will let you keep interacting with your computer, even when it is
under a heavy CPU load. Try our [CPUEater Demo][85] to experience ProBalance for yourself.

Process Lasso also allows users to automate and tweak how applications are run through a number of
unique and helpful functions. These include persistent priority classes, persistent CPU affinities,
disallowed processes, per-process power profiles, a process watchdog for advanced rules, process
instance count limits, multiple instance balancing and much more!

Process Lasso is the ultimate Windows CPU affinity changer. The CPU affinity specifies the set of
CPU cores an application is able to execute on. With Process Lasso, you can control this with a
persistent setting that applies every time the application is run, or change it dynamically while
the application is running once a threshold is met. The CPU affinity is commonly changed to limit
CPU use or improve performance.

Many additional functions such as power plan automation, a system responsiveness metric and process
activity logging are also available.

These features give you the ability to control how programs utilize your computer’s resources based
on automatically applied settings. With Process Lasso, you can decide exactly how you want your
processes to run.

## About Process Lasso

Process Lasso is Windows process automation and optimization software. Think of it as an automated
task manager. From tuning algorithms like [ProBalance][84] to user-created rules and persistent
settings such as CPU affinities and priority classes, Process Lasso gives you complete control to
run processes YOUR way!

Our novel ProBalance algorithm helps maintain system responsiveness during high CPU loads by
dynamically adjusting the priorities of running programs to keep problematic background processes in
check. With ProBalance, no longer will single, or multiple, processes be able to bring your system
to a virtual stall. Process Lasso will let you keep interacting with your computer, even when it is
under a heavy CPU load. Try our [CPUEater Demo][85] to experience ProBalance for yourself.

Process Lasso also allows users to automate and tweak how applications are run through a number of
unique and helpful functions. These include persistent priority classes, persistent CPU affinities,
disallowed processes, per-process power profiles, a process watchdog for advanced rules, process
instance count limits, multiple instance balancing and much more!

Process Lasso is the ultimate Windows CPU affinity changer. The CPU affinity specifies the set of
CPU cores an application is able to execute on. With Process Lasso, you can control this with a
persistent setting that applies every time the application is run, or change it dynamically while
the application is running once a threshold is met. The CPU affinity is commonly changed to limit
CPU use or improve performance.

Many additional functions such as power plan automation, a system responsiveness metric and process
activity logging are also available.

These features give you the ability to control how programs utilize your computer’s resources based
on automatically applied settings. With Process Lasso, you can decide exactly how you want your
processes to run.

## Don’t let intensive operations make you work IN your business

Distribution is operationally intensive business and managing day-to-day operations like ensuring
timely delivery of orders to optimising beat routes and providing exceptional customer service can
take all your time. These challenges can quickly become overwhelming and lead to decreased
efficiency, higher costs, and lower customer satisfaction. You may not realise that you’re working
IN the business and not ON the business. With Distributo focus on what really matters: streamlining
your growing distribution business.

Only once you are free from worries of everyday operations you can focus on growth. and Take your
distribution business to new heights. Automate checks and controls on your business process with
Distributo to make everyday management less dependent on you. Free yourself and focus on growing
your business.

## Verify Work as it Happens

Epicor Connected Process Control records and validates each production step as it occurs, whether
performed by an operator or automatically by connected equipment. Work instructions support manual
tasks while tools, sensors, PLCs, and test equipment record measurements and events during
execution.

Manufacturers gain immediate production visibility and complete traceability for every unit without
relying on after-the-fact inspection. This real-time verification helps teams support lean
manufacturing initiatives by preventing defects instead of correcting them later.

[[LEARN MORE]][31]

##### Configure Easily

Create workflows, instructions, and verification rules without programming. Update processes quickly
without complex system changes.

##### Connect Equipment

Connect tools, PLCs, sensors, and test equipment to automatically capture measurements and events
during execution.

##### Enforce the Process

Require confirmations, measurements, or equipment signals before the next step so incorrect work
cannot continue.

##### Record & Improve

Capture task-level production data and cycle times to identify bottlenecks and improvement
opportunities.

## Connected
